name: FN2
tagline: Cited financial research from filings, earnings calls and market data.
description: Submitted by the FN2 team. FN2 helps investors research public companies using SEC filings, earnings-call transcripts, market prices and macroeconomic data. Ask a research question, inspect linked sources, compare management commentary across quarters, or schedule recurring research briefings. The research product requires an FN2 account and has plan-based usage limits, with free accounts and paid plans available. Separately, fn2.ai/tools provides free earnings-surprise, quarterly-growth and GAAP-to-adjusted-EPS calculators with CSV export and no signup. These worksheets check arithmetic; they do not decide whether an adjustment is justified. FN2 provides research assistance, not brokerage order execution.
